title: Métriques métier — Supermarket Demo
description: Parcours golden signals : Métier (commandes, réassort, stock) → Traffic → Latency → Errors → Saturation. Les métriques techniques des microservices sont représentées par des courbes temporelles, avec une série et une légende par microservice lorsque la dimension est disponible.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_orders_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_orders_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY instance = resource.attributes.service.instance.id, channel = attributes.channel | EVAL channel_total = end - start | STATS total_orders = SUM(channel_total)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_stock_restock_requested_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_requested_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY instance = resource.attributes.service.instance.id | EVAL total_requested = end - start | STATS total_requested = SUM(total_requested)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_stock_restock_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY instance = resource.attributes.service.instance.id | EVAL total_completed = end - start | STATS total_completed = SUM(total_completed)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL requested_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_requested_total), completed_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_completed_total) | STATS requested_start = MIN(requested_counter), requested_end = MAX(requested_counter), completed_start = MIN(completed_counter), completed_end = MAX(completed_counter) BY instance = resource.attributes.service.instance.id | EVAL restock_gap = (requested_end - requested_start) - (completed_end - completed_start) | STATS restock_gap = SUM(restock_gap)

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_orders_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_orders_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), channel = attributes.channel | EVAL channel_total = end - start | STATS total_orders = SUM(channel_total) BY bucket

config.title: Métier — flux de réassort par période

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL requested_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_requested_total), completed_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_completed_total) | STATS requested_start = MIN(requested_counter), requested_end = MAX(requested_counter), completed_start = MIN(completed_counter), completed_end = MAX(completed_counter) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL requested = requested_end - requested_start, completed = completed_end - completed_start

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND attributes.channel == "rest" AND metrics.business_orders_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_orders_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL total_rest = end - start

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND attributes.channel == "kafka" AND metrics.business_orders_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_orders_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL total_kafka = end - start
FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.up IS NOT NULL | EVAL up_value = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.up) | STATS availability = AVG(up_value)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.process_cpu_usage IS NOT NULL | EVAL cpu_percent = 100 * TO_DOUBLE(metrics.process_cpu_usage) | STATS cpu_average = AVG(cpu_percent) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name, bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.jvm_memory_used_bytes IS NOT NULL AND metrics.jvm_memory_max_bytes > 0 | EVAL used = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_memory_used_bytes), max_memory = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_memory_max_bytes) | STATS memory_ratio = AVG(100 * used / max_memory) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name, bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.jvm_threads_live_threads IS NOT NULL | EVAL threads = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_threads_live_threads) | STATS live_threads = MAX(threads)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.process_cpu_usage IS NOT NULL | EVAL cpu = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.process_cpu_usage) | STATS cpu_average = AVG(cpu) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name, bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

config.title: Saturation — mémoire JVM dans le temps

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.jvm_memory_used_bytes IS NOT NULL AND metrics.jvm_memory_max_bytes > 0 | EVAL used = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_memory_used_bytes), max_memory = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_memory_max_bytes) | STATS memory_ratio = AVG(used / max_memory) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name, bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_stock_quantity IS NOT NULL | EVAL stock = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_quantity) | STATS stock = MAX(stock) BY product_id = attributes.product_id, product_name = attributes.product_name | SORT stock ASC

config.title: Traffic / Latency / Errors — statistiques HTTP par endpoint

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http_server_requests_seconds_max IS NOT NULL | EVAL duration_ms = 1000 * TO_DOUBLE(metrics.http_server_requests_seconds_max), error = CASE(attributes.outcome == "SERVER_ERROR", 1, 0) | STATS total_requests = COUNT(*), avg_ms = AVG(duration_ms), max_ms = MAX(duration_ms), total_errors = SUM(error) BY service = resource.attributes.server.address, method = attributes.method, endpoint = attributes.uri | EVAL error_rate = 100 * total_errors / total_requests | SORT avg_ms DESC
FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http_server_requests_seconds IS NOT NULL | STATS total_requests = COUNT(*)

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http_server_requests_seconds_max IS NOT NULL | EVAL max_ms = 1000 * TO_DOUBLE(metrics.http_server_requests_seconds_max) | STATS average_max_ms = AVG(max_ms)

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http_server_requests_seconds IS NOT NULL | EVAL error = CASE(attributes.outcome == "SERVER_ERROR", 1, 0) | STATS total = COUNT(*), total_errors = SUM(error) | EVAL error_rate = 100 * total_errors / total

config.title: Saturation — surcharge GC JVM dans le temps

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.jvm_gc_overhead IS NOT NULL | EVAL overhead = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_gc_overhead) | STATS gc_overhead = AVG(overhead) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name, bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND (metrics.kafka_consumer_fetch_manager_fetch_latency_avg IS NOT NULL OR metrics.kafka_producer_request_latency_avg IS NOT NULL) | EVAL fetch_avg_ms = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.kafka_consumer_fetch_manager_fetch_latency_avg), fetch_max_ms = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.kafka_consumer_fetch_manager_fetch_latency_max), producer_request_avg_ms = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.kafka_producer_request_latency_avg), producer_request_max_ms = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.kafka_producer_request_latency_max), consumed_rate = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.kafka_consumer_fetch_manager_records_consumed_rate), lag = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.kafka_consumer_fetch_manager_records_lag_max) | STATS fetch_avg_ms = AVG(fetch_avg_ms), fetch_max_ms = MAX(fetch_max_ms), producer_request_avg_ms = AVG(producer_request_avg_ms), producer_request_max_ms = MAX(producer_request_max_ms), records_consumed_rate = AVG(consumed_rate), lag_max = MAX(lag) BY client = attributes.client_name, topic = attributes.topic, partition = attributes.partition | SORT fetch_max_ms DESC

config.title: Latency — temps de traitement des messages Kafka

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_kafka_message_processing_seconds_max IS NOT NULL | EVAL duration_ms = 1000 * TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_kafka_message_processing_seconds_max) | STATS p50_ms = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 50), p95_ms = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 95), p99_ms = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 99), max_ms = MAX(duration_ms), messages = COUNT(*) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name, consumer = attributes.consumer, topic = attributes.topic | SORT p99_ms DESC

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.jvm_memory_used_bytes IS NOT NULL | EVAL heap_used_mb = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_memory_used_bytes) / 1048576, heap_max_mb = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_memory_max_bytes) / 1048576, cpu_percent = 100 * TO_DOUBLE(metrics.process_cpu_usage), live_threads = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.jvm_threads_live_threads), uptime_hours = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.process_uptime_seconds) / 3600 | STATS heap_used_mb = MAX(heap_used_mb), heap_max_mb = MAX(heap_max_mb), cpu_percent = AVG(cpu_percent), live_threads = MAX(live_threads), uptime_hours = MAX(uptime_hours) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name | SORT cpu_percent DESC

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.executor_pool_size_threads IS NOT NULL | EVAL pool_size = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.executor_pool_size_threads), active = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.executor_active_threads), queued = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.executor_queued_tasks), completed = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.executor_completed_tasks_total) | STATS pool_size = MAX(pool_size), active = MAX(active), queued = MAX(queued), completed = MAX(completed) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name | SORT queued DESC

config.title: Traffic / Latency — appels HTTP sortants par service

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.http_client_requests_seconds_max IS NOT NULL | EVAL max_ms = 1000 * TO_DOUBLE(metrics.http_client_requests_seconds_max) | STATS requests = COUNT(*), average_max_ms = AVG(max_ms), max_ms = MAX(max_ms) BY service = resource.attributes.service.name, method = attributes.method, host = attributes.uri | SORT requests DESC
